workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Cut storage incident triage from hours to minutes by building a diagnostics dashboard (C# APIs, React) that queries 200M+ telemetry events across regional clusters.
• Sped up cross-region log queries 40× (6 min → 9 sec) using partition pruning, pre-aggregated rollups, and asynchronous polling to work around gateway timeouts.
• Restored replication alerts for 3,000+ storage accounts by tracing a silent configuration drift across 4 service layers, from deployment manifests to runtime flags.
• Unblocked the team’s capacity planning within 72 hours by benchmarking 3 query strategies on 200M+ production events against a sub-5-second latency target.

• Building a GPU-accelerated sonar simulator on Georgia Tech’s PACE cluster to make underwater mapping experiments, which take thousands of runs, practical to repeat.
• Porting the lab’s CPU ray-tracing code to custom CUDA kernels, with tiled memory processing so 1M-point seafloor meshes fit on NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
• Benchmarking speedup and FP32 vs. FP64 precision against a multi-core CPU baseline on real survey data from the Gulf of Mexico.

projectsSection.projectDescription:
• Reduced hiking trail search latency 75% with FAISS vector indexing, enabling sub-100 ms similarity search across 25,000+ trail photos.
• Raised Top-5 precision to 86% (+31% relevance) with a ranking model combining CLIP image embeddings and each hiker’s saved trails.

• Launched a community garden planner with a team of 4, building all 6 React screens and an interactive plot map; grew to 150+ users in the first month.
• Trained a LightGBM model on 12 soil, weather, and planting features to predict which beds need watering, catching 85% of dry days at a 10% false alarm rate.
• Built the Flask backend with SHAP explanations and Gemini plain-language tips, adding output checks that block advice about pesticides.
• Kept the app running through weather API outages with a 2-tier cache fallback, covered by 24 backend tests.
